thesis: The supplied filing shows revenue and diluted EPS each rising about 11% year over year, with cash exceeding debt. That supports a small exploratory position at the supplied close of 100, equivalent to 20 times reported diluted EPS.
uncertainty: Both observations are synthetic and their origins are unauthenticated. One year-over-year comparison leaves the durability of growth uncertain, and the context provides no valuation benchmark.
allocation_reasoning: I chose a 5% all-in budget for this exploratory position given the limited evidence. At the cited price of 100, 49 shares plus the 1 fee cost 4901, or 4.901% of the starting book. That is below the 25% position cap and leaves 95099 in cash, above the 20000 minimum.

exit_conditions.text: Exit the simulated position if fresh fundamental evidence shows diluted EPS has stopped growing year over year or cash no longer exceeds debt.
